raidSayLines.line: You wake up with dirt in your mouth and blood on your hands that isn't yours. The sky is the wrong color — not sunset-wrong, wound-wrong. Sam Strong. Crossing guard. From Columbus, Ohio. That was yesterday. This is now. You have: Daughter's Drawing, Dad's Thermos, Photo album, Carpenter's square, Dispatcher's headset. That's everything you own in this world. Haven. Twelve people. The fire is lit.
📓 Journal: Food won't come to Haven. Walk past the treeline — learn what grows out there, bring it back, and get it named at camp.
Night. The treeline is just a sound now. The fire is the whole argument against it.

🛡️ Dawn at Haven. By the fire hangs an old bark cuirass, split at the seam — somebody's grandfather wore this into the treeline and came back. The shape of it is clear: bark plates laced overlapping like shingles, vine cord. Your hands don't know it yet. Your eyes do.
★ IDENTIFIED: Kudzu Root. Kudzu. A tangle of vines swallowing the treeline. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
Night. The treeline is just a sound now. The fire is the whole argument against it.
🦎 "Those were CALIBRATION fauna! First drafts! The audience has NOTES! So we made BETTER ones!" (Something new is crying in the treeline.)
Night. The treeline is just a sound now. The fire is the whole argument against it.
The Sweeps Week stops at the treeline — pacing, unwilling. The walls end the argument. It's still out there.
The village is rattled. Everyone's jumpy — eyes on the treeline.
Ava came back from the treeline white-faced. Saw it too. Whatever it is, it's still out there.
Night. The treeline is just a sound now. The fire is the whole argument against it.
Three shapes at the treeline — dog-shaped silences, circling. (A real pack is out there now: 3 of them. No names yet — nobody's lived to argue about one.)

💬 Tashi pulls you aside. "I need to tell you something. Last night I... dreamed? No. I was AWAKE. And something spoke to me. Not the System — something else. It said: 'Tell the human to watch the northern treeline.' Then it was gone."
🌙 Night. Shouts from the treeline — Sofia of Emberhold with 3 others, and they're not here to talk. "Your pantry or your blood. Choose." (They want ~2,000 kcal.)
📓 Codex: Sofia of Emberhold raids Haven's treeline — demands ~2,000 kcal.
🌙 You weren't at the treeline. Sofia of Emberhold didn't wait — they hit the stores and melted back into the dark with 1,000 kcal. The village will talk about this for a long time.
The village is rattled. Everyone's jumpy — eyes on the treeline.
Night. The treeline is just a sound now. The fire is the whole argument against it.

🌒 Dusk. They come out of the treeline in a knot — 3 of them, thin and road-worn — and stop at the edge of your firelight like they're not sure they're allowed closer. The oldest steps forward. "Darius Nair. From Stonebridge." A pause. "We're asking for a fire."
